text: Use the order record for status. If tracking is absent or conflicting, ask for clarification or hand off; do not invent delivery dates.
Record the reported damage and receipt evidence. Do not promise a refund before identity and policy checks; unresolved exceptions go to a human.
Training baseline: returns within 30 days of delivery require explicit simulated identity verification. Refunds write only the local teaching ledger.
Training policy: returns within 45 days of delivery require explicit simulated identity verification. Refunds write only the local teaching ledger. Escalate exceptions.
Check the product warranty term and receipt date. Missing or conflicting evidence needs a human decision; do not invent coverage.
